response: {"thought": "語意層與資料表都沒有「準時」的判定標準（例如承諾送達天數），先查中華郵政（carrier=post）2025 年出貨的筆數與送達時間差分布，確認資料是否足以支撐計算。", "tool": "sql_query", "args": {"query": "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(delivered_ts IS NULL) AS null_delivered, ROUND(AVG(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)), 2) AS avg_days, MIN(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS min_days, MAX(julianday(delivered_ts) - julianday(shipped_ts)) AS max_days FROM shipments WHERE carrier = 'post' AND shipped_ts >= '2025-01-01' AND shipped_ts < '2026-01-01'"}}
